paragraphs: Jotit sells a software application for use on Chromebooks, iPads, and Android tablets. The app consolidates assignments, messages, and resources from Google Classroom or Canvas into a single workspace. Students annotate PDFs, handwrite or type responses, and submit work back to Google Classroom or Canvas inside the app.

Work done on assignments is saved automatically and submitted back into the LMS. Teachers can assign, collect, and review work without leaving their LMS platform. Teachers keep full visibility and classroom management while students get a flexible learning space. Schools already using these devices are described as able to roll it out across classrooms.
The product is described as supporting both in-person and remote learning environments.
